run_libsize_check: run libsize.py to check the file size of a .so library and save it
run_libsize_compare: run libsize.py to compare a .so library size against a previously saved baseline
run_libsize_baseline: run libsize.py to establish a new size baseline for a .so library file
run_libsize_debug: run libsize.py to debug size changes in compiled .so library files across builds
run_libsize_monitor: run libsize.py to monitor and track .so library file size changes over time
